title: Sotsugyou Crossworld
overview:
Sotsugyou Crossworld is a multi-scenario romance adventure that brings together the ten heroines of Sotsugyou and Sotsugyou II, plus two new characters, for a total of twelve.

You play as a student at Seiryu High School or its sister school, Seiryu Girls High School. Spend your days on club activities and school events, head out to explore the nearby city, and talk with the people you meet. Grow close enough to someone and you may get the chance to go out with them.

- A cast of twelve characters
- Multiple scenarios illustrated with detailed artwork
- New endings and an original voice drama
